relationships.subject: BLA glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: the elevated excitability of BLAGlu neurons resulted in increased excitatory inputs to the ACC

relationships.subject: BLAGlu-ACC circuit
relationships.evidence_quote: Selective activation or inhibition of the BLAGlu-ACC pathway exacerbated or alleviated the pain and anxiety behavior, respectively.

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: these mice showed dysesthesia and anxiety-like behaviors 3 weeks after RTX injection

key_findings: PHN-anxiety patients show decreased BLA-ACC functional connectivity and amygdala volume.
Enhanced BLA glutamatergic input to ACC is necessary and sufficient for pain and anxiety-like behaviors in RTX mice.
